# Copilot instructions

This repository contains generated plugin publication output. Before changing
anything, read the [repository warning](../README.md).

Do not edit or commit generated files directly. Make changes in
[`sbroenne/mcp-server-excel`](https://github.com/sbroenne/mcp-server-excel) and
follow the source
[maintainer guide](https://github.com/sbroenne/mcp-server-excel/blob/main/.github/workflows/docs/publish-plugins-setup.md#maintenance-and-updates).
